breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The original prompt requested a subsurface carbon content (1.10 wt% C) that was physically impossible to achieve because it was higher than the surface concentration (0.90 wt% C). The ground truth corrected this by changing the target to a plausible value (0.60 wt% C). The agent, however, repeated the user's incorrect value, stating: "Assume a desired carbon content of 1.10 wt% C at a depth of 0.6 mm from the surface."
